title: The Leatherworker in Eighteenth-Century Williamsburg Being an Account of the Nature of Leather, & of the Crafts Commonly Engaged in the Making & Using of It.

The narrative combines historical context with practical details about the leatherworking process, highlighting challenges faced by leatherworkers in an economy that largely relied on imported goods.
